At a glance

Books and notes are stored locally. No account is required. Exported backups go where you choose. Google AdMob processes advertising and device information separately from your journal.

Your journal stays on your device

My Reading stores book titles, notes, entry identifiers, creation and update dates, and the order of your books in a local database. It also stores small preferences, such as whether you dismissed a help prompt.

There is no account registration or developer-operated journal server. The app does not upload your book titles or notes to us, and it does not include them in advertising requests. We do not have remote access to your journal.

Exports, imports, and device backups

When you choose Export in the three-dot menu, the app creates a JSON file containing your journal data and saves it to the destination you choose through your device’s file picker. Import reads a file you select and lets you merge entries or replace your current journal.

Exported files are readable text and are not encrypted by My Reading. Anyone who can access a file can read its contents. If you save or share a backup through a cloud drive or another app, that service processes it under its own terms and privacy policy.

Your operating system may also include app data in device backups, depending on its settings. These backups are managed by your device provider, rather than a My Reading cloud service.

Advertising and Google services

My Reading uses Google AdMob to display banner ads on the journey and thoughts screens. Google’s advertising and consent SDKs may process technical information such as IP address, device or advertising identifiers, app interactions, ad impressions and clicks, diagnostic information, and privacy choices. An IP address may be used to estimate a general location.

This processing supports ad delivery, measurement, fraud prevention, and consent management. The app requests non-personalized ads. Non-personalized does not mean that no information is processed; identifiers or device storage may still be used for these purposes.

Your book titles and notes are not supplied to Google by the app. Google controls its own retention and processing practices. Learn more in Google’s Privacy Policy, Google’s advertising information, and Google’s consent documentation.

Your privacy choices

Where required and configured for your region, Google’s User Messaging Platform presents a privacy message before ads are requested. When Google requires an ongoing privacy entry point, you can reopen it through Ad privacy options in the journey’s three-dot menu.

You can also manage advertising identifiers and advertising privacy settings through your device. Available settings vary by operating system and version. We do not request precise location, camera, microphone, or contacts access for journal features.

Keeping and deleting data

Your journal remains on your device until you delete entries, replace it during import, clear the app’s data, or remove the app. Deleting a book also deletes its notes from the app’s database. These actions do not remove previously exported files or copies in device backups.

To remove those copies, delete the files and manage backups with the relevant storage provider or device settings. Because we do not receive your journal, we cannot retrieve or remotely delete it. Google’s retention practices apply separately to information processed by its services.

Security and international processing

Your device’s access controls and storage protections help protect your local journal. Keep your device secure and protect any exported files. No method of storage or transmission can be guaranteed completely secure.

Google and any services you choose for backup or sharing may process information in countries outside your own. See those providers’ privacy policies for their safeguards and processing locations.

Children’s privacy

My Reading does not ask users to provide a name, age, or contact information in the journal. Advertising services may still process device and advertising information as described above. If you believe a child has provided personal information through a service associated with the app, contact us so we can help identify the appropriate next steps.

This website and contacting us

These pages do not contain analytics scripts, advertising SDKs, web forms, or tracking cookies. When published, the hosting provider may process standard request information, including IP address and browser details, to serve and secure the pages. External links are governed by the destination’s privacy practices.

If you email us, we receive your email address, the contents of your message, and any attachments you send. We use this information to respond to your request and retain it as needed for support. Please avoid sending private journal content unless it is necessary to explain your issue.

Depending on where you live, you may have rights relating to information processed about you. Contact us for information we hold through support; for data processed by Google, use the privacy controls and contact routes in Google’s policies.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy as the app or its services change. The date at the top identifies the latest revision. Material changes may also be explained in the app or its release information.

For privacy questions or support, contact Syntora Labs at support.syntoralabs@gmail.com.
